events.text: Own Goal by Jaydee Canvot, Crystal Palace. Brighton and Hove Albion 1, Crystal Palace 0.

Goal! Brighton and Hove Albion 2, Crystal Palace 0. Diego Gómez (Brighton and Hove Albion) right footed shot from more than 35 yards to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Olivier Boscagli following a fast break.
Goal! Brighton and Hove Albion 3, Crystal Palace 0. Yasin Ayari (Brighton and Hove Albion) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Charalampos Kostoulas.
Pascal Groß (Brighton and Hove Albion) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Crystal Palace. Dwight McNeil replaces Quinten Timber.

Goal! Brighton and Hove Albion 4, Crystal Palace 0. Charalampos Kostoulas (Brighton and Hove Albion) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner.Goal confirmed following VAR Review.
Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Crystal Palace. Jefferson Lerma replaces Honest Ahanor.
Substitution, Crystal Palace. Jean-Philippe Mateta replaces Jørgen Strand Larsen.
Substitution, Crystal Palace. Eddie Nketiah replaces Yéremy Pino.
Chema Andrés (Brighton and Hove Albion) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Brighton and Hove Albion. Jack Hinshelwood replaces Pascal Groß.
Substitution, Brighton and Hove Albion. Georginio Rutter replaces Charalampos Kostoulas.
Substitution, Crystal Palace. Will Hughes replaces Daichi Kamada.
Substitution, Brighton and Hove Albion. Jaouen Hadjam replaces Olivier Boscagli.
Substitution, Brighton and Hove Albion. Malick Yalcouyé replaces Yasin Ayari.
Goal! Brighton and Hove Albion 5, Crystal Palace 0. Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton and Hove Albion) right footed shot from very close range to the top left corner following a corner.
Substitution, Brighton and Hove Albion. Michael Svoboda replaces Lewis Dunk.
